highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the new Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn on Skia m152.
highlights_body: This preview also fixes several native use-after-free and memory-leak bugs, and adds backend-neutral async pixel readback.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now tracks Skia m152, with upstream m151 stability fixes merged along the way.
Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux.
SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works consistently across GPU backends.

bullets.lead: Fixed native use-after-free and memory-leak bugs
bullets.detail: SKRegion.SpanIterator, SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, and SKImage.Create's raster failure path no longer leave dangling native memory or leak a CoTaskMem pixel buffer.
Nano Server now uses FreeType for font support.

Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, avoids the double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, and pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Restored Nano Server font support by switching to FreeType
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Updated the m151 release line with upstream stability fixes
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.152.0 line with the Graphite GPU backend bindings, the Skia m152 bump, and several native memory-safety fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release with no API changes.
